title: PAN
text:
KANDASWAMY (MADURAI SOMASUNDRAM KANDASWAMY)** should be written as:  
| First Name  | M  | A  | D  | U  | R  | A  | I  |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| Middle Name  | S  | O  | M  | A  | S  | U  | N  | D  | R  | A  | M  |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |  
| Last Name  | K  | A  | N  | D  | A  | S  | W  | A  | M  | Y  |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |   |  
(i) **Do not** use abbreviations in Name. (ii) Name should **not** be prefixed with any title such as Mr, Mrs, Ms, Dr., Major etc.
[ 2. Gender ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#02)
It is mandatory to select one of the options as applicable. [ 3. Date of Birth ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#03)
Date: **2nd August 1975** should be written as:  
| D  | D  | M  | M  | Y  | Y  | Y  | Y  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
| 0  | 2  | 0  | 8  | 1  | 9  | 7  | 5  |  
[ 4. Aadhaar Number (if any) ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#04)
It is an optional field. [ 5. Country of Citizenship ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#05)
It is a mandatory field. [ 6. Citizenship Type](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#06)
It is mandatory to select one of the options as applicable. [ 7. Passport Number (if any) ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#07)
It is an optional field. [ 8. Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) in the Country of Residence ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#08)
It is a mandatory field. [ 9. Residence Address](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#09)
It is a mandatory field. [ 10. Office Address ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#10)
If office address is selected as address for communication, then proof of office address is mandatory
[ 11. Contact Details ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_95-form-96.html#11)
  1. It is mandatory for the applicants to mention their "Mobile Number" and "e-mail id". 2. Mobile Number should include Country Code and Landline Number (if any) should include STD Code.
